file_insights.changes_summary: Refactored request_list view to use apply_list_filters utility instead of manual filter handling
key_modifications: Added import for FilterConfig and apply_list_filters from apps.core.list_utils
Replaced manual search parameter extraction with FilterConfig declarations
Consolidated manual filter logic (status, priority) into FilterConfig array
Replaced manual Paginator implementation with apply_list_filters pagination handling
Updated context dictionary to extract paginated results from apply_list_filters return value
Simplified filter value extraction using result['filter_values'] dictionary

patterns_discovered.description: Extracted filtering logic into reusable apply_list_filters function with FilterConfig specifications
benefits: Makes views more maintainable and readable
patterns_discovered.implementation_details: FilterConfig objects specify param_name, filter_type ('search' or 'field'), and configuration kwargs

patterns_discovered.description: Search filters defined with array of searchable field names using ORM path notation
patterns_discovered.handles: Multi-field OR queries with icontains lookup

patterns_discovered.description: Filters defined as declarative configuration array rather than imperative conditional logic

gotchas_discovered.description: apply_list_filters returns dictionary with 'queryset' and 'filter_values' keys that must be accessed correctly
gotchas_discovered.impact: Context variables updated from result['filter_values'].get() instead of direct request.GET access
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Clear return value structure from utility function; documentation should specify keys

gotchas_discovered.description: filter_kwargs uses {value} placeholder syntax that must be correctly formatted for field filters
gotchas_discovered.risk: Incorrect mapping will fail silently or cause ORM query errors

gotchas_discovered.description: Ordering moved to apply_list_filters function parameter rather than manual order_by
gotchas_discovered.consideration: default_ordering parameter expects field name(s) in standard Django ORM format (e.g., '-request_date')

key_achievements: Successfully replaced manual filter handling with utility function
Maintained all original functionality (search, status filter, priority filter)
Updated context preparation to work with new return structure
Committed with clear message indicating automation and subtask completion

recommendations.rationale: The FilterConfig object structure and filter_type options need clear documentation for other developers to use apply_list_filters correctly
Ensure all views using apply_list_filters handle result['queryset'] and result['filter_values'] consistently; consider type hints

recommendations.recommendation: Add validation for filter_kwargs placeholder syntax
recommendations.rationale: Prevent runtime errors from incorrectly formatted {value} placeholders in FilterConfig definitions

recommendations.recommendation: Consider extracting FilterConfig definitions to module level
recommendations.rationale: If request_list view is frequently modified, defining filters at module level could improve maintainability

recommendations.recommendation: Extend apply_list_filters to handle related field filters
recommendations.rationale: Current implementation handles basic field filters; consider supporting complex filters on related objects (e.g., warehouse__name)

recommendations.recommendation: Implement unit tests for apply_list_filters utility
recommendations.rationale: As this utility is used across multiple views, comprehensive tests ensure consistency and prevent regressions
